column1: # OWASP ZAP alert thresholds for the API scan in .github/workflows/dast.yaml.
# Tab-separated: <ruleId> <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> <reason>. A rule absent from this file keeps
# THESE ARE SAMPLE VALUES. Every entry below is justified by something this repository's
# sample API or its CI environment does, and none of those justifications carries over to
# a real deployment. Re-derive the list against your own API before trusting it: an
# inherited IGNORE is a finding nobody will ever see again.
# The scan is report-only (see the workflow header), so FAIL is deliberately unused — it
# would change nothing today, and leaving it here would misdescribe the check.

column3: Re-examine Cache-control Directives — cache policy for this API belongs to the edge in front of it, which no template can choose
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — matches ordinary words in the JSON error vocabulary, on every response
Strict-Transport-Security Header — the ci profile sets SECURITY_HSTS_MAX_AGE=0 deliberately and the scan target is plaintext http inside the runner
Timestamp Disclosure — every sample resource carries created_at / updated_at, so this fires across the entire read surface
